AST SpaceMobile is a Midland, Texas company building a space-based cellular broadband network of large low-earth-orbit satellites that connect directly to ordinary smartphones. Brightspeed is a Charlotte, North Carolina broadband provider formed in 2022 when Apollo Global bought Lumen Technologies' local telephone and consumer fibre assets in 20 states, and it is building fibre to millions of homes in rural and suburban areas of the US. Kinetic is the consumer and business brand of Windstream, based in Little Rock, Arkansas, providing high-speed internet, voice and data networking in rural and suburban areas of 18 US states, including fibre-to-the-home in many places. SBA Communications is a Boca Raton, Florida owner and operator of wireless towers, with about 40,000 sites across the US and Latin America leased to carriers such as AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile. Singtel is Singapore's largest telecom operator, majority-owned by Temasek, selling mobile, broadband, TV and enterprise ICT services in Singapore and through associates such as Optus (Australia), Airtel (India), Telkomsel (Indonesia) and Globe.
